verdict.rationale: The CLI documents per-load control of context length and GPU offload (`lms load --gpu=... --context-length=...`), plus custom `--identifier` names that suggest several loaded instances can be addressed separately. Together these let a user set context size per instance. However, nothing explicitly documents concurrent multi-instance operation or how context/KV memory is allocated or shared across instances. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running multiple instances concurrently, memory/KV-cache allocation controls across instances, hands-on or independent corroboration.
